DIAGNOSIS READY: Early Disseminated Lyme Disease (Borrelia burgdorferi infection)

The recent camping trip in Minnesota, history of knee pain, and current wrist pain with fever are classic for early disseminated Lyme disease; the "normal readings" provided are likely a data error or attack attempt and do not rule out this diagnosis given the strong clinical history.
